session.question: What does the ClinicalTrials.gov record say about the DECISION phase III study design, treatment schedule, endpoints, and trial registration identifier?
session.answer:
The ClinicalTrials.gov record describes DECISION as a multicenter, double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled phase III study in patients with locally advanced or metastatic radioactive iodine (RAI)-refractory differentiated thyroid cancer. Patients remained on study treatment until radiographically documented disease progression, unacceptable toxicity, noncompliance, or withdrawal of consent. Efficacy assessments were performed every 56 days (2 cycles), and safety assessments every 28 days (1 cycle) for the first 8 months, then every 56 days thereafter. (brose2011rationaleanddesign chunk 1)

The primary endpoint was progression-free survival (PFS). Secondary endpoints included overall survival (OS), time to progression, disease control rate, response rate, duration of response, safety, and pharmacokinetic analysis. (brose2011rationaleanddesign chunk 1)

The trial registration identifier was ClinicalTrials.gov NCT00984282. (brose2011rationaleanddesign chunk 1)
